## Summary

Describe the change and the safety problem it addresses.

## Safety review

- [ ] Human authority remains explicit.
- [ ] External actuation remains deny-by-default.
- [ ] No offensive, destructive, covert or self-replicating capability is introduced.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour and failure mode.
- [ ] Threat model and documentation are updated when required.
- [ ] Only synthetic or explicitly authorised data is included.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results.
